title: The 3 biggest tech layoffs of 2026 and what they mean for developers

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you hear about the biggest tech layoffs of 2026?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s not just about jobs — it’s a sign of major industry shifts.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Meta, Amazon, and Google cut over 70,000 roles in the last quarter.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Meta’s layoffs hit AI and AR teams the hardest.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Developers in AI and cloud computing are now in high demand.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This means skills in machine learning and automation are more valuable than ever.
